b: The only way for something you create to be your best work is for everything else to be “not my best work.”
That’s okay. Half of all blog posts are below average, after all.

We can work to relentlessly raise the average. We can forgive the efforts that aren’t the best. And we can set aside our fear of failure (and success) to find the guts to create the next thing that will become our best work. So far.
